user.title: Heat pump
user.description: Pick the heat pump's existing climate entity. This integration creates a new thermostat that steers its setpoint.

sensors.title: Sensors

data_description.room_sensor: The sensor the controller regulates to (Mysa, Zigbee, anything).
data_description.compressor_freq_sensor: Used to learn when the compressor stops and to spot maximum output.
data_description.compressor_running_sensor: Optional. If empty, frequency above 0 counts as running.
data_description.indoor_coil_sensor: Used to detect defrost in heating.
data_description.discharge_temp_sensor: Demand is not raised further above the discharge limit.
data_description.unit_temp_sensor: Optional. The unit's own sensor at full resolution. If empty, the heat pump entity's current temperature is used.
data_description.link_sensor: Optional. When off, the unit sensors are ignored as stale.

sensors.description: Pick the room sensor to regulate to. The other sensors are optional but make control much better.

error.same_entity: Pick a room sensor, not the heat pump itself.

abort.already_configured: This heat pump is already set up.

data_description.room_sensor: The sensor the controller regulates to (Mysa, Zigbee, anything).
data_description.compressor_freq_sensor: Used to learn when the compressor stops and to spot maximum output.
data_description.compressor_running_sensor: Optional. If empty, frequency above 0 counts as running.
data_description.indoor_coil_sensor: Used to detect defrost in heating.
data_description.discharge_temp_sensor: Demand is not raised further above the discharge limit.
data_description.unit_temp_sensor: Optional. The unit's own sensor at full resolution. If empty, the heat pump entity's current temperature is used.
data_description.link_sensor: Optional. When off, the unit sensors are ignored as stale.

data_description.sensor_timeout: If the room sensor hasn't reported for this long, the unit is simply set to the target.
data_description.override_minutes: Pause control this long after someone changes the unit's setpoint directly. 0 disables.
data_description.kp: °C of extra demand per °C of room error.
data_description.ki: °C of extra demand per °C·hour of room error.
data_description.kff: °C of demand per °C between target and outdoor. Usually 0 until auto-tuned.
data_description.deadband: Room error smaller than this is ignored.
data_description.restart_hysteresis: Once the compressor stops, the room must drift this far from target before it restarts.
data_description.idle_margin: Hold the unit this far above its learned stop point so the compressor idles instead of stopping.
data_description.setpoint_step: Pick 0.5 °C only once the ESPHome device runs the tclac patch that sends half degrees; stock tclac rounds to whole degrees. Half-degree steps double the controller's resolution.

error.range: The highest setpoint must be above the lowest.

reset_learning.name: Reset learning
reset_learning.description: Forget the learned compressor stop and start points.

resume.name: Resume control
resume.description: End a manual override pause now.

kp.name: Proportional gain (Kp)
kp.description: °C of extra demand per °C of room error.

ki.name: Integral gain (Ki)
ki.description: °C of extra demand per °C·hour of room error.

kff.name: Outdoor feed-forward gain
kff.description: °C of demand per °C between target and outdoor. Usually 0 until auto-tuned.
